recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen standardization program. This includes documenting all recipes with precise measurements and cooking instructions, establishing clear quality control checks for incoming ingredients, and conducting regular training sessions for all kitchen staff on recipe adherence and plating standards.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in dish consistency and overall food quality, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat business.

recommendations.action: Develop and implement a mandatory customer service training program for all front-of-house staff, focusing on positive communication, conflict resolution, and proactive guest engagement. Additionally, review staffing levels during peak hours to ensure adequate support and reduce employee stress.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer experience, improved staff morale, and a reduction in negative service-related reviews.

recommendations.action: Conduct a time-motion study of kitchen workflows and service processes to identify bottlenecks. Implement operational improvements such as pre-shift prep checklists, optimized kitchen station layouts, and a robust reservation/table management system. Adjust staffing schedules to align with peak demand.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced customer wait times, increased table turnover, and improved operational efficiency.

recommendations.action: Review the menu pricing strategy in conjunction with portion sizes, ingredient costs, and competitor pricing. Consider offering value-added options (e.g., lunch specials, combo deals) or clearly communicating the quality and sourcing of ingredients to justify prices. Gather direct customer feedback on perceived value.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer perception of value, potentially leading to increased sales and reduced price-related complaints.

recommendations.action: Implement a structured feedback collection mechanism (e.g., comment cards, QR code surveys, direct manager check-ins) to capture specific details about 'other' negative experiences. Analyze this data regularly to identify emerging patterns or minor operational glitches.
recommendations.expected_impact: Proactive identification and resolution of minor issues before they escalate, leading to overall improved customer satisfaction.

recommendations.action: Conduct a walk-through audit of the dining area focusing on lighting, music volume, seating comfort, and overall cleanliness. Consider minor adjustments like adding sound-dampening elements, adjusting lighting for different times of day, or refreshing decor elements based on customer feedback.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced dining environment, contributing to a more positive overall customer experience.
